Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is a diversified chemical manufacturer based in Nanning, the capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in southern China. Positioned near major transport corridors that connect coastal ports with China’s southwest and ASEAN markets, the company benefits from efficient logistics for both raw materials and finished products. It serves a wide spectrum of customers in sectors such as agriculture, building materials, water treatment, mining, textiles, and consumer goods, supplying bulk and specialty chemicals that are integral to downstream manufacturing and everyday applications.

The company emphasizes reliable, consistent quality and process safety, operating under standardized quality-management and environmental-management systems that are designed to meet international expectations. Its production portfolio typically includes basic inorganic and organic chemicals, intermediates, and customized formulations produced to client specifications. In addition to large-volume manufacturing, Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. supports customers with technical service, application guidance, and collaborative product optimization aimed at improving performance and total cost of ownership.

Sustainability and responsible care are central to its operating philosophy. The company focuses on energy efficiency, emissions control, and waste minimization, and invests in cleaner production technologies where feasible. It also pursues ongoing R&D to enhance process yields, develop safer alternatives, and respond quickly to changing regulatory and market requirements. With a combination of regional supply-chain advantages, manufacturing expertise, and a customer-first approach, Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. positions itself as a dependable partner for domestic and international clients seeking stable supply and practical, chemistry-driven solutions.
